tweet.text: First look at gameplay for 'THE LEGEND OF ZELDA: OCARINA OF TIME' remake.

usage: Comparison only. Frames are downscaled to 640 px. Never load these as textures, backgrounds, or scenery (GAUNTLET.md §4.C).

shots.label: The Stairs
shots.notes: Link at bottom centre on flagstones; 18-step stairway rising to the upper-right ledge with fences; lantern branch left; shafts upper-left.

shots.label: Saria's House
shots.notes: Kokiri trunk house with mossy dome and 3 pod lanterns on the right; signpost; path north to mossy boulder terrace with small steps.

shots.label: Look Back
shots.notes: Stairs on the left climbing left; Kokiri kid on the grass; giant tree centre distance; heavy haze.

shots.label: The Log Arch
shots.notes: Short stairs right; giant hollow log across the far path in mist with lanterns; purple flowers + mossy boulder left foreground; falling leaves.

shots.label: Ground Close-up
shots.notes: Use the plaza flagstones + verge in frame 24 as the ground-material reference.

shots.label: Canopy & Shafts
shots.notes: Upper half of frame 8: canopy silhouettes with shafts breaking through.

shots.label: Equipment Screen (Phase 3)
shots.notes: Collection/Equipment/Items/System tabs, 16/200 rupees, hex slots, Kokiri Sword description.
